# ADR-0006 Original asset pipeline
Status: Accepted (B1 tooling), extend in B3
**Decision.** B1 assets are procedurally generated by versioned scripts (`tools/gen_*.py`, fixed seeds) writing engine runtime formats directly; review renders are produced from the exported files. B3 adds DCC tooling (Blender, licensed) with an exporter to W3D validated by the same checks. Any AI-generated image/model is recorded with tool, model, prompt and edits, and is a *source*, never shipped unedited/untested. No voice cloning of original actors; no score imitation.
